shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在四级台阶前，手里拿着一叠空白培训证书
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a four-step staircase holding a stack of blank training certificates and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天讲：在不同级别实验室，要学什么。
overlay: 一级到四级：各级实验室要学什么

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 四本颜色不同的空白培训手册排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four blank training manuals in a row, colored green, yellow, orange and blue. No people.
shots.narration: 级别越高，要学的越多、越深。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰拿着一张空白课程表，兴冲冲走向实验室
shots.prompt_en: The young male student walks eagerly toward a lab door holding a blank course schedule.
shots.narration: 阿杰要进二级实验室做课题。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰问小研，小研摇头指向培训室
shots.prompt_en: The young male student asks the female graduate student a question; she shakes her head and points toward a training room.
shots.narration: 他问：一级培训学过了，还用再学吗？

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 小研翻开空白培训手册给阿杰看
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens a blank training manual and shows it to the young male student.
shots.narration: 小研说：每一级要学的，都不一样。

shots.section_title: 生物安全是什么
shots.scene: 欣欣指着桌上密封的培养皿
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at sealed culture dishes on a clean bench.
shots.narration: 先复习：生物安全，讲的是安全操作

shots.section_title: 生物安全是什么
shots.scene: 带生物危害标志的密封盒在安全柜内
shots.prompt_en: A sealed box with a biohazard warning sign inside a biological safety cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 和控制感染性微生物、危险生物材料。

shots.section_title: 靠做法、程序、设备来保护
shots.scene: 规程本、安全柜、手套图标，被同一个防护圈罩住的人与树
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a procedure binder, a cabinet and gloves, next to a person icon and a tree icon under a protective dome. No people.
shots.narration: 靠做法、程序和设备，保护人和环境。
overlay: 靠做法、程序、设备来保护

shots.section_title: 防感染，防外泄
shots.scene: 病床图标打叉，密封瓶外的小点被挡住
shots.prompt_en: A crossed-out hospital bed icon beside a sealed bottle whose small dots stay inside a protective circle. No people.
shots.narration: 防止实验室感染，防止病原外泄。

shots.section_title: 防护等级：标准化措施
shots.scene: 四级台阶，每级一扇门
shots.prompt_en: A four-step staircase with a small door on each step. No people.
shots.narration: 防护等级，是一套标准化的防护措施。

shots.section_title: 一到四级，按危害定要求
shots.scene: 金字塔从浅黄到深红，每层旁有程序、设备、设施图标
shots.prompt_en: A pyramid from pale yellow at the bottom to deep red at the top, with procedure, equipment and building icons beside each layer. No people.
shots.narration: 从一级到四级，按危害定程序和设施。
overlay: 一到四级，按危害定要求

shots.section_title: 一到四级，按危害定要求
shots.scene: 四个数字方框，第一个最红，旁边一个反向箭头
shots.prompt_en: Four numbered boxes, the first deep red and the last pale green, with a reversing arrow beside them. No people.
shots.narration: 注意：国内病原第一类最危险，

shots.section_title: 一到四级，按危害定要求
shots.scene: 两排方框箭头方向相反
shots.prompt_en: Two rows of four boxes with arrows pointing in opposite directions. No people.
shots.narration: 和国际危险度分组方向相反。

shots.section_title: 级别不同，培训不同
shots.scene: 空白表格，三列各有一个图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank table with three column header icons: a target, a group of people and a clipboard. No people.
shots.narration: 每一级，看三件事：

shots.section_title: 级别不同，培训不同
shots.scene: 欣欣指着表格的四行逐行亮起
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a blank table whose four rows light up one by one in green, yellow, orange and blue.
shots.narration: 学什么重点，谁来学，怎么练。

shots.section_title: 一级重点：基本功和手卫生
shots.scene: 绿色背景，小研在洗手池认真洗手
shots.prompt_en: Green-tinted scene: the female graduate student washes her hands carefully at a lab sink.
shots.narration: 一级的重点：实验室一般安全，
overlay: 一级重点：基本功和手卫生

shots.section_title: 一级重点：基本功和手卫生
shots.scene: 接种环、培养皿、酒精灯图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an inoculation loop, a culture dish and a spray bottle of disinfectant. No people.
shots.narration: 基础微生物操作，

shots.section_title: 一级重点：基本功和手卫生
shots.scene: 洗手图标和台面擦拭消毒图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of hand washing and an icon of wiping a bench with disinfectant. No people.
shots.narration: 还有手卫生和台面消毒。

shots.section_title: 一级：学生和初学者
shots.scene: 阿杰和几位同学坐在教室里
shots.prompt_en: The young male student and several classmates sit in a classroom listening.
shots.narration: 谁来学？学生、实习人员和初学者。

shots.section_title: 一级示例：防护、溢洒、入门
shots.scene: 实验服、手套、护目镜图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a lab coat, gloves and safety goggles. No people.
shots.narration: 练什么？防护用品怎么穿戴，
overlay: 一级示例：防护、溢洒、入门

shots.section_title: 一级示例：防护、溢洒、入门
shots.scene: 吸附垫盖在一小摊液体上的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an absorbent pad covering a small puddle on a bench. No people.
shots.narration: 化学品洒了怎么处理，

shots.section_title: 一级示例：防护、溢洒、入门
shots.scene: 生物危害标志旁边一本入门手册
shots.prompt_en: A biohazard warning sign next to a blank beginner handbook. No people.
shots.narration: 以及认识生物危害。

shots.section_title: 二级重点：规程、锐器、安全柜
shots.scene: 黄色背景，王老师讲解一本空白规程
shots.prompt_en: Yellow-tinted scene: the safety administrator explains a blank standard operating procedure binder to students.
shots.narration: 二级的重点：标准操作规程，
overlay: 二级重点：规程、锐器、安全柜

shots.section_title: 二级重点：规程、锐器、安全柜
shots.scene: 密封试管在安全柜内的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a capped tube inside a biological safety cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 病原材料的安全操作，

shots.section_title: 二级重点：规程、锐器、安全柜
shots.scene: 针头入利器盒，回套针帽的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a used needle going into a sharps container, and a crossed-out icon of recapping a needle. No people.
shots.narration: 预防锐器伤，

shots.section_title: 二级重点：规程、锐器、安全柜
shots.scene: 小研在二级生物安全柜前规范操作
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works at a class two biological safety cabinet with the sash at the correct height.
shots.narration: 正确使用二级生物安全柜，

shots.section_title: 二级重点：规程、锐器、安全柜
shots.scene: 空白报告单与电话图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank incident report form next to a telephone icon. No people.
shots.narration: 出了事件及时报告。

shots.section_title: 二级：检验、科研、教学实验
shots.scene: 检验人员、科研人员、教学实验室三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a clinical lab bench, a research bench and a teaching lab with rows of benches. No people.
shots.narration: 谁来学？检验、科研人员和教学实验室。
overlay: 二级：检验、科研、教学实验

shots.section_title: 二级：检验、科研、教学实验
shots.scene: 阿杰坐进培训室，面前一本黄色手册
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sits in a training room with a yellow blank manual in front of him.
shots.narration: 做二级课题的学生，也要学。

shots.section_title: 二级示例：血液防护、去污、演练
shots.scene: 血滴图标外面一个防护盾
shots.prompt_en: A blood drop icon surrounded by a protective shield. No people.
shots.narration: 练什么？血液等样本的暴露防护，
overlay: 二级示例：血液防护、去污、演练

shots.section_title: 二级示例：血液防护、去污、演练
shots.scene: 安全柜台面被擦拭消毒
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand wipes the work surface inside a biological safety cabinet with disinfectant. No people.
shots.narration: 安全柜的使用和去污，

shots.section_title: 二级示例：血液防护、去污、演练
shots.scene: 小研和阿杰进行溅洒应急演练，王老师计时
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student practice an emergency response drill while the safety administrator watches with a stopwatch.
shots.narration: 还有暴露后的应急演练。

shots.section_title: 三级重点：空气传播防护
shots.scene: 橙色背景，空气流动箭头被一道屏障挡住
shots.prompt_en: Orange-tinted scene: air flow arrows stopped by a barrier wall with a filter icon. No people.
shots.narration: 三级的重点：更深入的生物安全原则，
overlay: 三级重点：空气传播防护

shots.section_title: 三级重点：空气传播防护
shots.scene: 空气中的小点被封闭在柜内
shots.prompt_en: Small dots kept inside a closed cabinet with arrows pointing inward. No people.
shots.narration: 可经空气传播病原的封闭控制，

shots.section_title: 三级重点：空气传播防护
shots.scene: 防护口罩与适合性检验的对勾图标
shots.prompt_en: A respirator mask icon next to a fit-check icon with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 呼吸防护，还要做适合性检验，

shots.section_title: 三级重点：空气传播防护
shots.scene: 一扇门进、一扇门出的图标，加应急铃
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an entry door and an exit door with arrows, plus an emergency bell icon. No people.
shots.narration: 以及进出程序和应急程序。

shots.section_title: 三级：有经验的专业人员
shots.scene: 老周和几位资深人员站在一起
shots.prompt_en: The older man stands with several experienced staff members in lab coats.
shots.narration: 谁来学？有经验的专业人员。
overlay: 三级：有经验的专业人员

shots.section_title: 三级：有经验的专业人员
shots.scene: 阿杰在门外，门上画禁止进入图标
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stops outside a lab door that shows a no entry sign.
shots.narration: 学生未经批准，不得进入三级实验室。

shots.section_title: 三级示例：复训、熟悉设施、模拟
shots.scene: 日历上每年圈出一个日子
shots.prompt_en: A calendar with one date circled each year. No people.
shots.narration: 练什么？定期复训，
overlay: 三级示例：复训、熟悉设施、模拟

shots.section_title: 三级示例：复训、熟悉设施、模拟
shots.scene: 空白平面图上的路线箭头
shots.prompt_en: A blank floor plan with route arrows drawn on it. No people.
shots.narration: 熟悉设施布局，

shots.section_title: 三级示例：复训、熟悉设施、模拟
shots.scene: 呼吸防护装备的清洁和检查图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a respirator being cleaned and inspected with a checklist. No people.
shots.narration: 呼吸防护装备的使用和维护，

shots.section_title: 三级示例：复训、熟悉设施、模拟
shots.scene: 模拟演练的图标：假人和计时器
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a training mannequin and a stopwatch for a simulated drill. No people.
shots.narration: 还有溢洒和感染事件的模拟演练。

shots.section_title: 四级重点：长期强化训练
shots.scene: 蓝色背景，日历翻过好几页
shots.prompt_en: Blue-tinted scene: calendar pages flipping over many weeks. No people.
shots.narration: 四级的重点：数周到数月的强化训练，
overlay: 四级重点：长期强化训练

shots.section_title: 四级重点：长期强化训练
shots.scene: 一套正压防护服的图标
shots.prompt_en: A simple icon of a full-body positive-pressure protective suit with an air hose. No people.
shots.narration: 正压防护服的使用，全封闭程序，

shots.section_title: 四级重点：长期强化训练
shots.scene: 喷淋去污的图标
shots.prompt_en: A simple icon of a decontamination shower. No people.
shots.narration: 严格的去污方案，

shots.section_title: 四级重点：长期强化训练
shots.scene: 心形与对话气泡图标，两个人形并排
shots.prompt_en: A heart and speech bubble icon, next to two person icons standing side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 必要时评估身心状况，坚持两人同行。

shots.section_title: 四级：专门的专业团队
shots.scene: 一群穿防护服的人形图标
shots.prompt_en: A group of person icons in protective suits. No people.
shots.narration: 谁来学？专门的病原研究和公共卫生团队。

shots.section_title: 四级示例：全流程演练
shots.scene: 流程图：进入、工作、撤出三个格子
shots.prompt_en: A flow chart with three boxes connected by arrows: entering, working and leaving. No people.
shots.narration: 练什么？全流程模拟演练，

shots.section_title: 四级示例：全流程演练
shots.scene: 缓冲间门与喷淋图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an anteroom door and a decontamination shower. No people.
shots.narration: 进出缓冲间和化学淋浴的练习，

shots.section_title: 四级示例：全流程演练
shots.scene: 对讲机图标和紧急出口图标
shots.prompt_en: An intercom icon next to an emergency exit sign. No people.
shots.narration: 通讯规程和紧急撤离预案。

shots.section_title: 培训要记录、签字、复训
shots.scene: 空白培训记录表上的签名栏被签上
shots.prompt_en: A blank training record form with signature lines being signed. No people.
shots.narration: 每一级的培训，都要留下记录，

shots.section_title: 培训要记录、签字、复训
shots.scene: 阿杰在记录表上签字，王老师在旁确认
shots.prompt_en: The young male student signs a blank training record while the safety administrator confirms.
shots.narration: 本人签字，考核合格才能准入。

shots.section_title: 培训要记录、签字、复训
shots.scene: 日历上循环箭头
shots.prompt_en: A calendar with a circular arrow icon. No people.
shots.narration: 还要定期复训，周期按本校规定。

shots.section_title: 二级以上必须动手练
shots.scene: 阿杰戴手套在安全柜前练习，小研指导
shots.prompt_en: The young male student wearing gloves practices at a biological safety cabinet while the female graduate student guides him.
shots.narration: 二级及以上，必须动手实练。

shots.section_title: 二级以上必须动手练
shots.scene: 只有书本的图标打叉，书本加手套的图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: A crossed-out icon of only a book, next to a checked icon of a book plus gloved hands. No people.
shots.narration: 光看书、光听课，不算学会。

shots.section_title: 三四级先带教，再放手
shots.scene: 老周在旁边看着一位年轻人操作
shots.prompt_en: The older man stands beside a young staff member and watches closely as she works.
shots.narration: 三级、四级，先有老师傅带教跟岗，

shots.section_title: 三四级先带教，再放手
shots.scene: 门禁卡交到手中，旁边一个对勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank access card being handed over, with a green check mark beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 确认能独立胜任，才给完全准入。

shots.section_title: 换新实验，补专项培训
shots.scene: 阿杰面前出现一台新仪器和一份新方案
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks at a new instrument and a new blank protocol on the bench.
shots.narration: 换了新实验、新设备，怎么办？

shots.section_title: 换新实验，补专项培训
shots.scene: 王老师给阿杰单独讲解新仪器
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator explains the new instrument to the young male student one-on-one.
shots.narration: 先补专项培训，再动手操作。

shots.section_title: 久未操作，复训再上手
shots.scene: 积了灰的实验服挂在门后，日历翻过好几个月
shots.prompt_en: A lab coat hanging behind a door with a calendar beside it showing many months passed. No people.
shots.narration: 很久没进实验室，手生了，

shots.section_title: 久未操作，复训再上手
shots.scene: 小研在带教下重新练习操作
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student practices again at a cabinet under the guidance of the older man.
shots.narration: 先复训、再确认，然后上手。

shots.section_title: 没把握就问，别硬做
shots.scene: 阿杰面对一个步骤犹豫，头顶出现问号
shots.prompt_en: The young male student hesitates at the bench with a question mark above his head.
shots.narration: 遇到没把握的步骤，

shots.section_title: 没把握就问，别硬做
shots.scene: 阿杰停下手，去问老周
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts down his tools and goes to ask the older man.
shots.narration: 先停下来，问老师或实验室负责人。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 欣欣站在四色台阶前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of the four-step staircase colored green, yellow, orange and blue.
shots.narration: 小结：一级打基础，二级练规程，

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 台阶上两级高亮
shots.prompt_en: The upper two steps of the staircase glow. No people.
shots.narration: 三四级要专门训练，先带教再准入。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 培训记录表、日历、手套图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a training record form, a calendar and gloved hands. No people.
shots.narration: 培训有记录，定期复训，动手实练。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣、小研、阿杰在培训室门口挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the female graduate student and the young male student wave goodbye at the door of a training room.
shots.narration: 学到位、考合格，再进实验室。
